title: Content Governance
subtitle: Review campus materials, manage global content, and govern featured placements.

review.title: Editorial review queue
review.description: Only submitted, in-review, or approved versions awaiting publication.
review.publishedDescription: Review published versions and archive content with an auditable reason.
review.publishedEmpty: No published content is available for governance.
review.empty: No content is waiting for an editorial action.
review.author: Author
review.detailDescription: Read-only preview and authoritative editorial decision history.
review.noPrevious: There is no previously published version.
review.historyEmpty: No editorial decisions have been recorded.
review.readOnlyCampus: Campus content is review-only. Super Admin cannot change its body or attachments.
review.selfReview: A global content author cannot review their own item. A different Super Admin must review it.
review.revisionDescription: Explain the changes required from the campus Admin. You cannot edit the content directly.
review.rejectDescription: Rejection is an editorial decision distinct from a revision request. The version remains available for audit.
review.publishDescription: This becomes the reader version and is immutable after publication.
review.archiveDescription: The item will be removed from reader APIs. An archive reason is required.
review.loadError: Governance data could not be loaded.
review.stale: This content changed in another session. Your note is preserved while the latest state is loaded.
review.invalidTransition: The content state changed and this action is no longer available.
review.noteRequired: Enter a note of at least 10 characters.
review.question: Question

global.title: Global content
global.description: Create and revise global content. Publication still requires review by a different Super Admin.
global.secondReview: Global content follows submit, review, approve, and publish. The author cannot review the same item.

featured.title: Featured content placements
featured.description: Assign ranks 1–5 to published Articles. Date windows affect featured visibility only.
featured.removeDescription: The Article remains published; only its placement is removed.
featured.eligibleEmpty: No published Article is eligible for this scope.
featured.conflict: That rank or Article is already active in the same scope.
featured.stale: The placement changed in another session. The latest data is being loaded.
featured.invalidWindow: The end time must be the same as or later than the start time.
